name: TaskUpdate
description: Mutate an existing task. Fields absent from the call do not change. `status: "deleted"` removes the entry from the registry. Returns `updatedFields` listing which fields changed and an optional `statusChange` for transitions. Use TaskGet afterwards to retrieve the full post-update record.

taskId.description: The id of the task to update

status.description: New status — one of pending, in_progress, completed, cancelled, deleted

addBlocks.description: Task ids that this task blocks

addBlockedBy.description: Task ids that block this task

metadata.description: Metadata keys to merge. Set a key to null to delete it.
